message.content:
Using integration by parts:

Let:
- \(u = \log(x)\), so \(du = \frac{1}{x} dx\)
- \(dv = dx\), so \(v = x\)

Then:

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x*\log(x) - \int x*\frac{1}{x} dx
\]

Simplify the integral:

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x*\log(x) - \int 1 dx
\]

Integrate:

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x*\log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
